蓝色为数学模型，金色为近似或对照。有限窗口会裁切超出范围的曲线，图示不代替证明。: Blue shows the mathematical model; gold shows approximations or comparisons. Curves beyond the finite plot are clipped. Visuals are not proofs. Controls support keyboard and numerical input.
已到本次演示的参数终点。图中仍是有限截断或有限精度计算；收敛与误差条件见正文。: This animation has reached its parameter endpoint. The display still uses finite truncation or precision; see the text for convergence and error conditions.
当前曲线为 $r=2\\cos(2\\theta)$。负半径把点放在角度反方向；: The current curve is $r=2\cos(2\theta)$. Negative radius places points opposite the angle direction. Parameter-swept shading may overlap.
二维坐标图，横轴向右、纵轴向上。加减键缩放，Home 恢复。: 2D plot: horizontal rightward, vertical upward. Use plus/minus to zoom and Home to reset.
三维几何，三轴使用相同单位。拖动或方向键旋转，加减键缩放，Home 恢复；可切换: 3D geometry with equal axis units. Drag or use arrow keys to rotate, plus/minus to zoom and Home to reset. Top and front projections are available.
数值与公式在图下提供。: Values and formulas are provided below the plot.
拖动旋转 · 方向键也可操作: Drag or use arrow keys to rotate
俯视：高度被投影到同一平面: Top view: height is projected onto one plane
在图内上下拖动可调整零时刻的初始值；下方输入框和滑块也可操作。: Drag vertically within the plot to change the initial value at time zero. Inputs and sliders below also work.
在图内拖动可调整初始状态；下方输入框和滑块也可操作。: Drag within the plot to adjust the initial state. Inputs and sliders below also work.
已到本次参数的明确终点。趋零演示保留正数下界；有限图示不等于无穷极限的证明。: The animation has reached its stated endpoint. Parameters approaching zero retain a positive lower bound; a finite visual is not a proof of an infinite limit.
三维视图可拖动旋转。点按图形后，方向键旋转、加减号缩放、Home 恢复。手机请在: Drag the 3D view to rotate. After focusing the plot, arrow keys rotate, plus/minus zoom and Home resets. On mobile, drag inside the plot; the text remains scrollable. Top and front views compress a direction; return to 3D to inspect occlusion. Geometry is computed locally from vector coordinates without WebGL.

图像只显示有限范围；读数采用有限精度。: Only a finite plot range is shown; readouts use finite precision.
收敛结论来自解析极限；阴影只画出当前有限截断。: Convergence follows from the analytic limit; shading shows only the current finite truncation.
二维图显示圆锥母线；面积为绕横轴旋转后的侧面积，不含底面。: The 2D plot shows the cone's generating line. Area is the rotated lateral surface about the horizontal axis, excluding the base.
末项可能因显示精度看起来等于 2；数学上的有限项仍小于 2。: Rounding may make the last term appear equal to 2; each finite mathematical term is still below 2.
函数在半径外有值，不代表这份级数在那里收敛。超出图窗的曲线会被裁切。: A function value outside the radius does not make this series converge there. Curves beyond the plot window are clipped.
玫瑰线会出现负半径，阴影按参数过程扫过，可能重叠；累积量不是自动去重的面积。: The rose has negative radii. Parameter-swept shading can overlap; the accumulated amount does not remove repeated coverage.
参数区间决定方向与描绘次数，有限采样只用于显示。: The parameter interval determines direction and repeated tracing. Finite sampling is used only for display.
方向场只画局部斜率；金色折线是离散近似。存在、唯一性与有效区间由正文条件判断。: The direction field shows local slopes; the gold polygon is a discrete approximation. See the text for existence, uniqueness and valid-interval hypotheses.
三维坐标使用相同单位尺度。图形是有限网格，读数来自给定模型；投影不能代替证明。: All three axes use equal unit scales. Geometry uses a finite mesh; readouts follow the specified model. Projection does not replace proof.
非严格极小，沿纵向恒定；二阶严格判别无结论。: Nonstrict minimum, constant in the second direction; the strict second-derivative test is inconclusive.
金色小块保持倾角宽度 0.1、方位角宽度 0.16 弧度。: The gold patch keeps inclination width 0.1 and azimuth width 0.16 radians.
金色梯度箭头按 0.5 倍显示；蓝色单位方向保持长度一。: The gold gradient arrow uses scale 0.5; the blue unit direction keeps length one.
原点未定义；图面最内圈半径 0.04 是显示裁切，不是函数边界。所选点可继续靠: The origin is undefined. The innermost plotted ring at radius 0.04 is display clipping, not a domain boundary. The selected point may approach to 0.0001.
绿色为指数曲面，蓝色为二阶模型；两图使用相同坐标，显示窗口为中心附近。: Green shows the exponential surface; blue shows the second-order model. They share coordinates and a window near the center.
金色目标梯度按 0.5 倍、蓝色约束梯度按 0.35 倍显示。: Gold objective-gradient arrows use scale 0.5; blue constraint-gradient arrows use scale 0.35.
固定径向宽度 0.2、角宽 0.25 弧度；近似使用内边半径，有限宽度下与精确: Radial width is fixed at 0.2 and angular width at 0.25 radians. The approximation uses the inner radius, differing from exact area at finite width.
像区域的纵向一阶矩: Image region's first moment in the second coordinate
蓝色为原单位正方形，绿色为像区域；金色标出当前参数切片。局部倍率不是总面积。: Blue shows the original unit square; green its image. Gold marks the selected parameter slice. The local factor is not total area.
场箭头统一按 0.22 倍绘制，不做逐根归一化。: All field arrows use scale 0.22; none are individually normalized.
亮色弧为已累积的线段。: The bright arc marks the accumulated path.
场箭头按统一倍率 0.22 显示。: Field arrows use a common scale 0.22.
亮色方格为参数单位正方形，外围网格用于空间定位。: The bright patch is the parameter unit square; the surrounding grid gives spatial context.
旋度箭头按 0.5 倍绘制，边界小箭头只表示正向。零鼓起时闭合实体退化为零体积: Curl arrows use scale 0.5; small boundary arrows show orientation only. At zero bulge, the enclosed solid has zero volume.
箭头为质量通量场（此处速度为位置向量），统一按 0.22 倍显示。: Arrows show mass flux (here velocity is position), with common scale 0.22.
